name: commander
description: Self-hosted GitHub push auditor that writes satirical military communiques to Discord, with a full control panel.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @commander/shared && npm run build -w @commander/api && npm run build -w @commander/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @commander/shared && npm run typecheck -w @commander/api && npm run typecheck -w @commander/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @commander/shared && npm run test -w @commander/api && npm run test:guards
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
